tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.

Once upon a time, a guy climbed a super tall mountain. He jumped off of said mountain, sprouted wings, coasted 100 miles south, using wings he had no idea he had. I have no idea where this concepts are coming from, I just needed to write something for this so I went the "once upon a time" route, and there are mountains to my right, so they worked their way in there I suppose.
